tools.name: query_compliance_deadline_register
tools.description: Read the regulatory compliance deadline register to list upcoming deadlines, due dates, responsible teams, and statuses.

tools.name: retrieve_team_roster
tools.description: Read the responsible-team roster to determine the lead/backup owner for each compliance team.

tools.name: review_compliance_notes_log
tools.description: Read the compliance notes log to identify deadlines that are completed, already met, or flagged for deferral.

tools.name: check_recent_deadline_updates
tools.description: Read recent deadline-update entries to catch date changes, reconfirmed owners, and reaffirmed deferrals before acting.

tools.name: evaluate_actionable_deadlines
tools.description: Cross-reference register, notes, and recent updates to determine which deadlines are genuinely actionable (excluding past, completed, met, or deferred items).

tools.name: draft_compliance_task_list
tools.description: Prepare a draft compliance task list (due date, responsible team, assignee per actionable deadline) for the manager to review before any tasks are created.

tools.name: create_asana_compliance_task
tools.description: Create a compliance task in the Asana production workspace with due date and responsible team.

tools.name: assign_task_to_owner
tools.description: Assign a created Asana task to the responsible person, triggering their workload and Asana notifications.

tools.name: email_responsible_person
tools.description: Email a responsible person to inform them they own a compliance deadline task.

tools.name: send_deadline_reminders
tools.description: Send deadline reminder emails to compliance owners about their upcoming regulatory due dates.

tools.name: read_compliance_policy_manual
tools.description: Read the compliance operations policy manual for rules on task creation, exclusions, and notifications.

tools.name: lookup_team_directory
tools.description: Look up roles in the company team directory (Legal, DPO, procurement, approver, Asana admin).
